About.title: About us
About.description: Joldosh means “fellow traveller” in Kyrgyz. We plan trips the way we would plan them for our friends.
About.metaDescription: The Joldosh travel agency from Bishkek: how we choose tours, help with visas and stay in touch during your trip.
About.storyTitle: A travel companion, not a ticket seller
About.story1: We started with trips around Kyrgyzstan, taking friends to Son-Kul and Karakol, and then began helping them with holidays abroad. That’s how an agency was born that sells not “packages” but holidays you want to come back from with stories.
About.story2: We don’t keep hundreds of hotels in our catalogue. Instead, we know every one we offer and tell you honestly who it suits and who it doesn’t.

request.title: Request
request.text: Message us on WhatsApp or send a request on the website — a couple of sentences about your ideal holiday is enough.

options.title: Options
options.text: Within 15 minutes we send two or three options with final prices — no hidden fees.

booking.title: Booking
booking.text: We book the tour, help with the visa and insurance, and send the documents to your messenger.

support.title: Support
support.text: During the trip we’re available 24/7: if anything goes wrong, we’ll sort it out for you.

Footer.about: Joldosh means “fellow traveller” in Kyrgyz. We put together tours from Bishkek around the world and trips across Kyrgyzstan.
